نستزيد (form X)
# نَسْتَزِيدُ (nastazīdu) /nas.ta.ziː.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَزَادَ (istazāda)
# نَسْتَزِيدَ (nastazīda) /nas.ta.ziː.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَزَادَ (istazāda)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
